## Review Report: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title for Cloned Cards

### Executive Summary

The implementation is complete and correctly matches the spec. `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` has been added to `studio/src/utils.js` with exactly the logic described in the plan — stripping trailing `-N` suffix, then incrementing until a unique candidate is found. In `showClone()`, `existingTitles` is built from `Store.fragments.list.data.get()` (correctly scoped to current tag path), and `this.titleClone` is set via `generateUniqueTitle` before the dialog renders. The dialog textfield was updated from `value="${this.fragment.title}"` to `value="${this.titleClone}"`. Both `node --check` validations pass. One minor omission: `cancelClone()` does not explicitly reset `titleClone` to `''` as the spec mentions, though this is functionally benign since `showClone()` always re-computes `titleClone` before display.

---

### Issues by Severity

#### tech_debt

**#1 — `cancelClone()` does not reset `titleClone`**

- **File**: `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js:1128-1133`
- **Description**: The spec (Step 4) says "Also reset `titleClone` in `cancelClone()` to `''` (already done at line ~1123-1128; ensure it is reset there)." However, `cancelClone()` resets `tagsClone` and `osiClone` but not `titleClone`. The omission is functionally benign — `showClone()` recomputes `titleClone` from scratch every time it runs — but deviates from spec's explicit instruction and leaves stale state between cancel and re-open in edge cases.
- **Recommended fix**: Add `this.titleClone = '';` in `cancelClone()` alongside the other resets.

---

### Plan Compliance

| Acceptance Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| Cloning a card whose title exists produces `-1` suffix default | ✓ PASS — `generateUniqueTitle` returns `base-1` on first conflict |
| Cloning again produces `-2`, `-3`, etc. | ✓ PASS — loop increments until candidate not in Set |
| Original card's title unchanged | ✓ PASS — only `titleClone` is mutated, `fragment.title` untouched |
| Manual title edit in dialog used verbatim | ✓ PASS — `updateCloneFragmentInternal` updates `titleClone` on input; no re-dedup |
| Uniqueness scoped to `Store.fragments.list.data` | ✓ PASS — `existingTitles` built from store list before dialog opens |
| No two cards share same Fragment Title after clone | ✓ PASS — unique title pre-populated by default |
| `node --check studio/src/utils.js` passes | ✓ PASS |
| `node --check studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` passes | ✓ PASS |

---

### Verdict: PASS

No blocker issues. All acceptance criteria are met. One `tech_debt` item (missing `titleClone` reset in `cancelClone()`) with no functional impact.
